metadata.title: The multiscale Routing Model mRM v1.0
metadata.description:
The multiscale Routing Model mRM

  • The current release is mRM v1.0.
  • General information can be found on the mHM website (www.ufz.de/mhm).
  • All the details of the code can be found in the user manual.
  • The mRM comes with a LICENSE agreement, this includes also the GNU Lesser General Public License.

Please note:The GitLab repository (https://git.ufz.de/mhm/mrm) grants read access to the code. If you like to contribute to the code, please contact mhm-admin@ufz.de.

Install

Please see the file DEPENDENCIES for external software required to run mRM. See also the users manualfor detailed instructions to setup mRM.

Quick start

  1. Compile mRM with the make command, which uses settings from Makefile.
  2. Run mRM on a test basin with the command ./mrm, which uses settings from mrm.nml.
  3. Explore the results in the output directory, e.g. by using the NetCDF viewer ncview.
